title: The Bio-Age Dawns on the Judiciary -- Ch. 3: A Primer on the APJR
link: The Bio-Age Dawns on the Judiciary (book)
primary_topics: Chapter 3 'A Primer on the APJR': an overview of the judiciary's Action Program for Judicial Reform 2001-2006, founded on CJ Davide's vision, and its reform components
sub_topics: APJR as the judiciary's concrete response to improving service, image, and accountability
Founded on CJ Hilario Davide Jr.'s 'Davide Watch' vision and mission
The 156-page APJR document and its 'Executive Summary'
Reform components: judicial education, capacity building, appointments, remuneration, organizational culture, public information, networking

stances.claim: The APJR is the judiciary's concrete, long-term program to become an efficient, trustworthy, and accountable dispenser of justice.

notable_anecdotes: He reprints the 'Executive Summary' of the 156-page APJR as an introductory chapter, drawing on his earlier book 'Reforming the Judiciary.'
one_paragraph_summary: Chapter 3, 'A Primer on the APJR,' summarizes the judiciary's Action Program for Judicial Reform 2001-2006 — the concrete response, founded on Chief Justice Hilario Davide Jr.'s 'Davide Watch' vision, to make the courts efficient, trustworthy, and accountable. CJP reprints the program's Executive Summary and outlines its reform components: judicial education, capacity building, appointments, remuneration, organizational culture, and public information.
